items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I don't know they was going to say this when they get back to the office to Mrs. Reddy, that was the lieutenant's name, Lt. Reddy.

ctx.x: This was an American who said this to you?

He was an American. So by that time the bus driver comes out for the bus and the security guards that were inside that brought me out, they came out. They had to bring me out to the bus and they came out, when the bus driver came out, they came out, the security guards, and they saw these guys and these guys left. I get on the bus.

Now do you know what all the people in the show had in mind, I was drunk. I wasn't drunk, never was so sober in my life. But I don't know they was going to say this when they get back to the office to Mrs. Reddy, that was the lieutenant's name, Lt. Reddy. I didn't think they were going to tell her this, 'cause I wasn't drunk. But they told her I was drunk.
